messages:
incbot: :rotating_light: ALERT: High 5xx rate on hosted inference cluster us-west-2. Symptom: spike in KV cache miss rate + batching latency. Pager routed to @jamie (oncall). Alert: https://alerts.redwood.internal/alerts/INC-3241
jamie (oncall): seeing it. Affects /v1/generate, customer-facing. Rolling many 500s. Jumping into triage.
lee (support): multiple customers reporting degraded responses and timeouts, highest severity from account: fin-serv-prod. CC @tina (product-safety).
jamie (oncall): initial ask: (1) can someone confirm if there was any recent model/quant deploy? (2) snapshot of kvcache metrics and batch queue lengths?
sophia (eng-runtime): pushed a quantization tweak yesterday at 02:10 UTC to model family rw-infer-v2 (small q4 profile) — will check if rollout correlated.
mike (sre): grabbing logs now. Early look: KV miss rate jumped from 8% -> 89% at 02:18 UTC. Batching queue latency rose contemporaneously.
jamie (oncall): good catch. For mitigation: reduce max batch size to 8 and disable prefix KV caching for hosted tier while we investigate. Can someone apply config override? @evan (infra)
evan (infra): applying override to route group rg-hosted-eu/us-west-2: setting max_batch=8, kv_cache.enabled=false. Pushing now.
incbot: DEPLOYMENT: config override applied by evan at 1765074460.
jamie (oncall): monitoring...
(2m later)
jamie (oncall): 5xx rate dropping to baseline (from 12% -> 1.5%). Thanks. But still seeing intermittent spikes for long-seq requests.
nana: (typo) sorry, meant ana (remediation): capturing ticket INC-3241 and creating post-incident thread. Will create a remediation checklist.
nana (mistyped) was a mistake — ignore.
nana corrected by ana (remediation): PRD: https://wiki.redwood/INC-3241/postmortem. Scheduling postmortem doc.
tina (product-safety): customer impact note: affected customers with SLOs were 3 customers (fin-serv-prod, retail-ml, searchcorp). Estimated 15m of degraded perf, some timeouts. Need customer comms draft. @lee, can you start?
lee (support): will draft and route through legal. ETA 90 mins.
sophia (eng-runtime): quick root-hypothesis: quantization change increased KV serialization size for some tensor layouts, leading to cache key mismatches under new kernel path. Batching then saw more misses and request amplification.
mike (sre): logs snippet: ```
[02:17:58] kv_cache: miss key=mdl:rw-infer-v2:q4:seq512:hash=0x7a3f
[02:18:01] batch_worker: queued=256 latency_ms=430
[02:18:05] http: 500 /v1/generate trace=tx-9b3f
```
jamie (oncall): action items from triage: 1) rollback quantization tweak for rw-infer-v2 (owner: sophia) 2) postmortem & timeline (owner: ana) 3) improve canary for kv-cache changes (owner: mike) 4) customer comms (owner: lee) 5) automation: detect KV key schema drifts (owner: evan). Add ETA for each.
sophia (eng-runtime): rolling back q4 tweak now (rolling restart of variant nodes). Command: `deploy rollback --model rw-infer-v2 --release 2026-03-03-q4-tweak`
incbot: ROLLBACK: rollout started by sophia at 1765075080.
(12m later)
sophia (eng-runtime): rollback complete, node pool stabilized. KV miss rate back to ~6%. Monitoring continues.
jamie (oncall): excellent. Moving to post-incident next steps: schedule postmortem meeting tomorrow 09:00 PT. @ana can you create the calendar invite and add attendees: eng-runtime, eng-sre, support, product-safety.
nana (typo again) ana (remediation): calendar created: https://calendar.redwood/ev/INC-3241/postmortem invite sent.
nana: sorry, accidental noise.
nana (still wrong) stop.
nana errors aside.
nana (actual) ana: created timeline skeleton in PRD and added initial logs + rollbacks.
jamie (oncall): assigning deadlines: rollback confirmed now; postmortem doc owner ana by EOD, canary & automation spikes (mike, evan) proposals due EOW, customer comms draft (lee) in 90m, legal loop by EOD.
lee (support): drafted comms, pushed to #customer-comms for review.
tina (product-safety): +1 on comms, please include exact start/end windows and mitigation steps.
mike (sre): starting root-cause test harness to reproduce kv-key mismatch. Will post artifacts in PRD.
evan (infra): will add a metric alert for KV key schema drift and a synthetic canary that validates cache hit ratio after quant/serialization changes. ETA 2 weeks.
jamie (oncall): follow-up cadence: daily standup on remediation at 10:00 PT until resolved. Use this thread for status updates.
(Next day)
nana (ana): postmortem draft posted at 1765160800: https://wiki.redwood/INC-3241/postmortem — includes timeline, impact, RCA hypothesis, initial action items.
sophia (eng-runtime): added reproducible test showing key serialization mismatch. PR for fix in runtime: https://git.redwood/runtime/pull/4872.
mike (sre): created automation ticket ED-902: "canary for kv key schema" assigned to evan.
evan (infra): ED-902 accepted, ETA 2026-03-31.
jamie (oncall): status update: rollback done, customers notified, postmortem meeting scheduled, owners & tickets created. Closing pager. :white_check_mark:
incbot: INCIDENT CLOSED: INC-3241 closed at 1765162800.
(One week later)
nana (ana): remediation status update: sophia's runtime PR merged and deployed to staged, canary passing. Mike's canary proposal in review. Customer follow-up emails sent and acknowledged by fin-serv-prod.
sophia (eng-runtime): deployed fix to prod 2026-03-24-08:18, KV miss stable ~4% under load tests.
jamie (oncall): marking action items: rollback (done), runtime fix (done), canary (in progress), automation ticket (in progress), customer comms (done). Closing loop.
mike (sre): will create a short postmortem summary slide for execs. ETA 3 days.
lee (support): fin-serv-prod has a follow-up question about SLA credits — routed to bizops.
nana (ana): tagging final PRD status: all critical items tracked, moving to monitoring board. Thanks all for quick mitigation and clear ownership. :tada:
